Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Anjali - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Tanay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay hugs Mother tightly.]

Anjali: "Tanay, listen!"

[Tanay sneezes loudly.]

Tanay: "What happened?"

[A hailstorm begins.]

Tanay: "What a day to remember!"
